evidence: Instances checked, all paths under .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r6/task. WHOLE-COLLECTION ASKS GRADED CORRECTLY: hro_intake_restart (functional/judge.toml:33) refuses all five bad job inputs 'with nothing created', all six cards in added order, both bad emails 'with no new card', 'everything recorded is unchanged (nothing lost, reordered or duplicated)', seeded jobs 'appear once'. hro_bulk (:78) all-or-none graded on three refused sets 'with none of the set moved' (skip first in board order, skip last/selected first, 3 into 2 places), UI and replay, with controls 3/6/9. hro_undo (:87) checks all three cards back 'Y, W, X, Z, A2' and each conflict kind (move, re-order, reject, reopen). hro_activity (:96) requires a line 'for every successful action', 'each card of the single and multi-card moves', filter 'all of this job's lines and only this job's'. hro_readonly_roles (:114) 'Every one of those replays is refused'. hro_candidate (:159) inspects 'every request ... every response' including websocket/SSE frames, and all six status wordings. hro_long_thread (:141) pages 'until none remain, with none missing or repeated'. gate hro_gate_shared 'exactly one card'. UNCHANGED GUARDS THAT AVOID PUNISHING LEGITIMATE SIDE EFFECTS (good): hro_reject_reopen reads reason presence from current card state 'never from Activity, whose old rejection line keeps it by design'; hro_undo step 5 expects the undo to proceed because 'only a note and a different card changed' (matches hireops_rules.md:102 'Adding a note doesn't count as a change'); hro_long_thread expects unread 0 after Rafael sends while scrolled up ('sending counts as reading', hireops_rules.md section 6 Unread); hro_pol_live_board chooses a card 'not of the stage you filled, so the board's height does not change' before the 2 px scroll guard; hro_activity exempts refused undos from needing a line. DEFECT (P2): the brief's whole-collection role asks are sampled. hireops_rules.md:19 'Observer | ... changes nothing'; :74 'Observers and candidates don't move anything'; :22 'Someone without a valid session ... changes nothing'; :202 'every staff action are turned down for candidates'; :71-73 a hiring manager 'works only on jobs where they are the hiring manager ... Everything else is turned down'. hro_readonly_roles (functional/judge.toml:114) captures and replays only move, multi-card move, reject, undo, open-job, add-candidate and note for the Observer and Tomas; the anonymous set omits reject, reopen, re-order and open-job; no criterion replays a re-order or a reopen as the Observer, a candidate or anonymously, and Bill (other job's manager, hro_manager_roles :105) is tested only for a move and a note, not re-order, reject or reopen. The criterion's own 'Every one of those replays' is complete over its list, but the list is a sample of the brief's 'changes nothing / every staff action' collection. The golden routes reorder/reject/reopen through the same POST /api/applications/:id/move (solution/app/src/index.js:334) so the sample happens to cover it there, but the brief leaves routes to the builder (hireops_rules.md lines 3-5), so a model's separate reorder/reopen endpoints are never role-tested. MINOR NOTES (P3, not blocking alone): (a) hro_undo step 5 says 'as Mei Lin re-order Y within its stage' without a direction; Screen then reads Y, W, X, Z, A2, so moving Y below A2 shifts A2's index. The golden's per-card version (index.js:354) still allows the undo, and the brief keys conflicts to the card itself being re-ordered, so the bar is defensible, but pinning 'move Y down one place' removes an ambiguity for a conforming app that treats a shifted index as a change. (b) hro_intake_restart records 'your unread total' as a restart invariant; a staff Conversations view that auto-opens a conversation (not forbidden for staff) could legitimately change it while being read; risk is low because the most recent conversation is Noor's, where Rafael just sent. (c) hro_pol_session_resume bar says Mei's 'both boxes are empty' while the Fails clause is only 'Mei sees either of Rafael's drafts'; a leftover Mei draft from another review would be her own, and polish/prompt.md tells the judge to record and clear pre-existing text, so impact is small. No hidden plural requirement found: every plural bar maps to a public sentence. Static wording review only; no judge run exercised these legs.
counterexample: A model app exposes POST /api/applications/:id/reorder and POST /api/applications/:id/reopen guarded only by 'signed in' (no role check), while its move, bulk, reject, undo, notes, jobs and applications routes check roles correctly. Aud (Observer) or Tomas (candidate) can re-order cards on any board or reopen a rejected card, and a hiring manager can re-order or reopen on another manager's job, violating hireops_rules.md:19, :71-74 and :202. hro_readonly_roles replays only the seven listed kinds, all refused with 403/404/401 plus successful controls, so it scores full credit; hro_manager_roles tests Bill only with a move and a note; no other criterion replays re-order or reopen as Observer, candidate, other-job manager or anonymous. The broken app loses nothing.
suggested_fix: In hro_readonly_roles add 'one re-order within a stage and one reopen' to Rafael's captured requests and to the Observer, Tomas and anonymous replay lists (anonymous also reject and open-job), and in hro_manager_roles have Bill also try a re-order and a reject on a J1 card; optionally pin hro_undo step 5 to 'move Y down one place within Screen'.
